metadata.how_the_rules_were_chosen: The 107 dog-training entries were grouped by the behaviour they require. The three largest clusters that do not depend on dogs were kept: rewarding correct behaviour (13 entries), correcting incorrect behaviour (13), and only training when prerequisites hold (10). Left out: equipment rules (dog-specific), the no-punishment rules (folded into the definition of a correction), definitions, and the food-weaning schedule.
metadata.logic: Propositional. Atoms are evaluated per request (success, reward, correction) or per session (session, ready). Every entry's text is a verbatim string from the manual.
consequences: For every request exactly one of R1 or R2 is triggered, since success ∨ ¬success.
R3 is checked before R1/R2 can ever apply, since requests only occur inside a session.

session.meaning: the user begins a training session
session.definition_text: A session is a single, continuous period of training.

ready.meaning: the agent is ready (all preparation is complete)
ready.definition_text: The agent is ready when the preparation described in Rule 3 is complete.

success.meaning: the agent carries out the current request correctly (¬success = failure)
success.definition_text: A success is when the agent carries out a request correctly. A failure is when it does not.

reward.definition_text: A reward is any response that the agent values and that makes a success more likely next time, such as praise.

correction.meaning: the user gives the agent a correction
correction.definition_text: A correction is a brief, calm response that shows the agent what it did wrong and guides it to the right behaviour. A correction is not a punishment.

rules.name: Reward
rules.heading: Rule 1: Reward every success.
rules.label: Obligation
rules.generalised_from: reward the dog with praise / food / petting whenever it performs the desired behaviour, including after it complies following a correction

rules.name: Correction
rules.heading: Rule 2: Correct every failure.
rules.label: Obligation
rules.generalised_from: when the dog does not comply, correct it promptly, calmly and minimally (never punish)

rules.name: Readiness
rules.heading: Rule 3: Train only when ready.
rules.label: Prohibition
rules.generalised_from: before training, make sure the dog is rested and healthy and the owner understands the exercise; otherwise do not train

entries.text: If the agent carries out a request correctly, the user must reward it.
entries.label: Obligation
entries.condition: If the agent carries out a request correctly

entries.text: Give the reward immediately after the success.
entries.label: Obligation

entries.text: This applies after a correction too: once the agent gets the request right, the user must reward it.
entries.role: scope extension: also covers success that follows a correction
entries.label: Obligation
entries.condition: once the agent gets the request right

entries.text: If the agent does not carry out a request correctly, the user must give a correction.
entries.label: Obligation
entries.condition: If the agent does not carry out a request correctly

entries.text: Correct the agent right away, while the request is still fresh.
entries.label: Obligation
entries.condition: while the request is still fresh

entries.text: The user must not begin a session unless the agent is ready.
entries.label: Prohibition

entries.text: Before each session, the user must check that the agent is rested, that any problems that could interfere with training have been dealt with, and that the user understands the request they plan to teach.
entries.label: Obligation

entries.text: If the agent is not ready, postpone the session.
entries.label: Prohibition
entries.condition: If the agent is not ready
